actual_behavior_limitation: The mncs.test-result/1 provenance carries runner and source path/sha but no effective library roots, so a debugger re-executing the embedded request cannot resolve the same modules the test run saw (MNE173 on mncs.test.assertions) unless the caller supplies roots out of band. mncs-debug already recovers provenance.libraries when present (runner.build_witness); the producer never emits it.
current_workaround: The environment passes obligation-declared library_paths plus the test provider's descriptor-declared adapter_library_paths explicitly to import-test. Auditable and provider-owned, but a side channel next to the result document.

host_language_code_required.classification: explicit transport of declared roots; no semantic workaround
host_language_code_required.why: Host resolves declared roots and passes them as import-test flags.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Emit the effective MNCS library roots (path plus content digest) in mncs.test-result/1 provenance for every run, so any consumer can re-execute the embedded request against the identical module closure.
resolution_criteria: import-test reproduces a witness for an mncs.test.assertions-importing suite with no --library flags and no ambient MNCS_LIBRARY_PATH, resolving roots solely from the result document.
tests_evidence: ambient-debug campaign probe 2026-10-01 (MNE173 without explicit roots; success with obligation plus adapter roots)
title: Test results should carry effective library roots for debugger re-execution
why_capability_matters: Without producer-emitted roots, every re-execution consumer must independently rediscover the module closure the test ran against, which risks drift between the observed failure and the debugged execution.
